raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes (01-04) instead of region names. silver_customers passes them through unmapped. raw_region_map, referenced in the 2026-01-15 CRM change note, gives the mapping, so the fix is to translate the codes to names in silver_customers.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_customers":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code"}}
